scope: Independent read-only results review; no application, setup, browser, benchmark or bound-harness execution.
disposition: Close C2 missing configured-startup observation; retain accepted lazy-formatter trade-off. Not release approval.

commands.label: candidate-lineage

limitations: Only two observations per source on one local host; ranges are not confidence intervals.
Fresh process/module graph with source/fixture guard reads, not OS-disk-cold startup.
noSync and deferred dataset start isolate configured local startup; ordinary mixed gate retains scheduler/provider/load responsibility.
Configured startup includes first projection but does not instrument or identify formatter-only cost.
First wire timing includes loopback HTTP/client overhead.
All warm intermediate output checks are enforced by the immutable worker; raw result archives first/final wire and all timings, not each intermediate state.

Fixture SQLite/vault payloads were hash-verified by the observation worker then removed by actual cleanup; independent audit can recompute manifest fingerprints and receipt bindings, not rehash the deleted payloads.
No browser, GPU, physical OBS or total OBS CPU claim; no matched broad production gain/regression claim.
